full_translation_en: The provided text is a list of members of various committees of the House of Representatives. It does not contain any narrative or procedural information about a meeting. The committees listed are: Finance Committee, International Relations and Tourism Committee, Industry, Commerce and Labour and Consumer Interest Committee, Law, Justice and Human Rights Committee, Agriculture, Cooperatives and Natural Resources Committee, Infrastructure Development Committee, Women and Social Affairs Committee, State Affairs and Good Governance Committee, Education, Health and Information Technology Committee, and Public Accounts Committee. Each committee lists its members by name, prefixed with 'मा०' (Honorable).
